ACTION.NAME: READ_BY_PARTID_VENDORLOT_VENDORSHIPLOT_PARTNUMBER
ACTION.STATEMENT: SELECT TOP (@MaxRows) [PartId], [VendorId], [VendorLot], [PartNumber], [PartNumberRev], [EntryDate], [EWO], [PartStatus], [EmployeeId], [LastUpdateDate], [Quantity], [CustomerPartNumber], [VendorShipLot], [VendorWaffleId], [VendorWaffleLocation] FROM [Manufacturing].[dbo].[PartMaster] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE [PartId] LIKE @PartId AND [VendorLot] LIKE @VendorLot AND ISNULL([VendorShipLot], '') LIKE @VendorShipLot AND ISNULL([PartNumber], '') LIKE @PartNumber ORDER BY [PartId] DESC
